presets.yaml:
# Checked on a GPU in session S2 (2026-10-21, L4): clean once a description of the photo comes before this text (docs/S2_RESULTATS.md).
# Note: the two moves run one after the other (combine: then), through the Montagio Camera Embedding node (comfy-nodes).
schema: montagio/preset@0.1
id: breathing
name: Breathing
description: A barely visible push in and out that keeps a still shot alive.
preview: previews/breathing.mp4
license: CC-BY-4.0
author: montagio-community
capability: i2v-camera
camera:
  poses: [zoom_in, zoom_out]
  combine: then
  speed: 0.2
prompt:
  suffix: "barely perceptible breathing camera, gentle micro push in and out, calm and steady"
  negative: "blurry, distorted, warped faces, extra limbs, flicker, low quality"

  resolution: 480p
  fps: 16
models:
  preferred: wan22-i2v-a14b-fun-camera-turbo
  fallback: wan22-ti2v-5b
# Turbo (4 steps) by default: GPU session of 2026-10-25 kept this move in 4 steps (docs/S2_RESULTATS.md part 14); Quality stays one click away.
